title: Structure-guided discovery of a dual JAK2/RAGE modulator reveals a computationally driven strategy for targeting convergent oncogenic signaling in renal cell carcinoma.
authors: Mohammad-Al-Shahrani, Mesfer; Abohassan, Mohammad; Rajagopalan, Prasanna
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子药物靶向JAK2/RAGE蛋白的虚拟筛选与分子动力学模拟，对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Renal cell carcinoma (RCC) is driven by convergent inflammatory and proliferative signaling pathways. RAGE-mediated NF-kappaB activation and JAK2-STAT3 signaling cooperate to amplify cytokine production and oncogenic progression. Targeting these interconnected pathways represents a rational therapeutic strategy. High-throughput virtual screening of ChemBridge libraries, 100 ns molecular dynamics simulations, and MM/PBSA analysis were performed. The lead compound RJS6641 was evaluated using biochemical assays (HTRF JAK2 kinase assay, differential scanning fluorimetry), a cell-free AGE-RAGE binding ELISA, and functional assays in RCC cell lines, including viability, reporter, cytokine, apoptosis, and migration analyses. RJS6641 showed stable binding to JAK2 (protein RMSD  approximately 0.28 nm; ligand RMSD 0.15-0.20 nm) and RAGE (protein RMSD 0.50-1.50 nm; ligand RMSD 0.30-0.35 nm). It inhibited JAK2 in an ATP-competitive manner (IC(5)(0) = 60.23 nM; ruxolitinib IC(5)(0) = 1.69 nM), with ATP-dependent shifts (35.04 --> 74.09 --> 305.6 nM) and thermal stabilization (DeltaTm +1.50  degrees C). AGE-RAGE binding was disrupted (IC(5)(0) = 118.2 nM). RJS6641 reduced RCC viability (GI(5)(0): 799.8-2021 nM) while sparing HK-2 cells (GI(5)(0) 12,816 nM; 6-16x difference). It suppressed STAT3 (IC(5)(0) 412.3-813.2 nM) and NF-kappaB (IC(5)(0) 435.7-1031 nM) signaling, reduced IL-6/IL-8 secretion, induced caspase-3/7 activation (EC(5)(0) 662.4-862.9 nM), and inhibited migration (up to 83%). Collectively, RJS6641 functions as a JAK2 inhibitor with additional modulation of RAGE-associated signaling, leading to coordinated suppression of STAT3/NF-kappaB pathways and anti-tumor effects in RCC, supporting further in vivo and selectivity evaluation.
abstract_zh: 肾细胞癌（RCC）由趋同的炎症和增殖信号通路驱动。RAGE介导的NF-kappaB激活与JAK2-STAT3信号协同作用，放大细胞因子产生和肿瘤进展。靶向这些相互关联的通路代表了一种合理的治疗策略。进行了ChemBridge文库的高通量虚拟筛选、100 ns分子动力学模拟和MM/PBSA分析。先导化合物RJS6641通过生化测定（HTRF JAK2激酶测定、差示扫描荧光法）、无细胞AGE-RAGE结合ELISA以及RCC细胞系中的功能测定（包括活力、报告基因、细胞因子、凋亡和迁移分析）进行评估。RJS6641显示出与JAK2的稳定结合（蛋白质RMSD约0.28 nm；配体RMSD 0.15-0.20 nm）和RAGE（蛋白质RMSD 0.50-1.50 nm；配体RMSD 0.30-0.35 nm）。它以ATP竞争性方式抑制JAK2（IC(5)(0) = 60.23 nM；ruxolitinib IC(5)(0) = 1.69 nM），具有ATP依赖性位移（35.04 --> 74.09 --> 305.6 nM）和热稳定性变化（DeltaTm +1.50摄氏度）。AGE-RAGE结合被破坏（IC(5)(0) = 118.2 nM）。RJS6641降低RCC活力（GI(5)(0)：799.8-2021 nM），同时保护HK-2细胞（GI(5)(0) 12,816 nM；差异6-16倍）。它抑制STAT3（IC(5)(0) 412.3-813.2 nM）和NF-kappaB（IC(5)(0) 435.7-1031 nM）信号，减少IL-6/IL-8分泌，诱导caspase-3/7激活（EC(5)(0) 662.4-862.9 nM），并抑制迁移（高达83%）。总体而言，RJS6641作为JAK2抑制剂发挥作用，并额外调节RAGE相关信号，导致STAT3/NF-kappaB通路的协同抑制和RCC中的抗肿瘤效应，支持进一步的体内和选择性评估。
